services.name: Bike Swap
services.desc: Check out our Labor Day Bike Swap on Monday, September 7, 2026. The day will feature great deals on used bikes from motivated sellers. Important seller information is below. Bikes can be dropped off between 10 a.m. and 4 p.m free of charge by September 6th. Bikes will be registered, priced, and seller information will be collected, including a credit card for a security deposit. Bikes can be dropped off the day of the event between 9-9:30am but require a $25 registration fee. BVAC staff will help sell registered bikes. Sellers are welcome to be present, but not required. services.name: Sledding & Tubing
services.desc: Bear Valley Adventure Company offers both groomed tubing and sledding hills. In general, the tubing hills are small and medium in size and fun for the whole family. We recommend tubing for ages 3 and older. Sledding hills are steeper and longer, offering exciting rides for those a little more adventurous. Both areas require participants to walk up the hills. Hot food and drinks are available nearby at the Meadow Cafe.
